description: This file implements the EmailCampaignWritePlatformService for managing email campaigns within the Apache Fineract platform. It includes methods for creating, updating, deleting, activating, reactivating, and closing email campaigns, as well as inserting campaigns into outbound email tables, previewing messages, and handling report data retrieval specific to email campaigns.

classes.name: EmailCampaignWritePlatformCommandHandlerImpl
classes.description: Implementation of the service handling CRUD and operational commands for email campaigns integration with the Fineract platform.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates a new email campaign based on the provided JSON command, validating inputs, fetching related reports, and persisting the campaign.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates an existing email campaign if it is not active, handling validation, report association, and persistence.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Marks an email campaign as deleted (setting visibility to zero) if it is not active.

methods.name: insertDirectCampaignIntoEmailOutboundTable
methods.description: Inserts email messages directly into the outbound email table for immediate dispatch based on campaign parameters.

methods.name: activateEmailCampaign
methods.description: Activates an email campaign, scheduling or sending immediately based on campaign type.

methods.name: closeEmailCampaign
methods.description: Closes an active email campaign with a specified closure date.

methods.name: compileEmailTemplate
methods.description: Compiles an email message template using Mustache with provided email parameters.

methods.name: getRunReportByServiceImpl
methods.description: Retrieves report data for email campaigns, processing the generic result set into a list of maps.

methods.name: previewMessage
methods.description: Generates a preview of the email message based on sample data for testing before activation.

methods.name: reactivateEmailCampaign
methods.description: Reactivates a previously deactivated email campaign, updating trigger dates as necessary.

methods.name: handleDataIntegrityIssues
methods.description: Handles data integrity exceptions during database operations, throwing appropriate errors.
